posts.title: The Switch Is Still Off
posts.description: The Twitter switch is still off. Two years have passed since I exited X. Looking back, I probably should have left sooner. The post The Switch Is Still Off first appeared on Jeff Turner .

posts.title: Bumping My Head Was The Best Thing That Happened To Me This Year
posts.description: Sometime in late March, I leaned in to get something from our car, and when I stood up, thankfully, I wound up bumping my head on the latch. The post Bumping My Head Was The Best Thing That Happened To Me This Year first appeared on Jeff Turner .

posts.title: Artificial Intelligence Is 70 Years Young Today
posts.description: Artificial intelligence is unusual in so many ways. One unique aspect of AI is that it has a verifiable birthday. Most sciences don't. The post Artificial Intelligence Is 70 Years Young Today first appeared on Jeff Turner .
